parts: @Flextor97 The paper names the alternative: "This establishes alternative (C) in the Millennium problem statement for Navier-Stokes as stated by Fefferman", plus (D) on T3. (C) and (D) permit "a smooth f(x, t)". Only (A) and (B) take f identically zero, so forcing isn't the disqualifier.
